Bash(duckdb -c "SELECT filename, regexp_extract(filename, ''/([^/]+).parquet$'', 1) as extracted FROM read_parquet(''data/parquet-raw/BTC/*.parquet'', filename=true) LIMIT 3")

Bash(duckdb -c "SELECT COUNT(*) as total, COUNT(futures_price) as has_futures, COUNT(delta) as has_greeks, COUNT(CASE WHEN is_valid THEN 1 END) as is_valid FROM read_parquet(''data/parquet-duckdb/BTC.parquet'')")

Bash(duckdb -c "
SELECT 
  regexp_extract(instrument_name, ''^([A-Z]+-[0-9]{1,2}[A-Z]{3}[0-9]{2})-'', 1) as expiry,
  COUNT(*) as total_trades,
  COUNT(futures_price) as with_futures,
  ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(futures_price) / COUNT(*), 1) as pct_coverage
FROM read_parquet(''data/parquet-duckdb/BTC.parquet'')
WHERE expiry != ''''
GROUP BY expiry
ORDER BY pct_coverage ASC
LIMIT 20
")
